title: Kicked Up Turkish Chicken Kebabs
description: A sour and light Turkish dish featuring dark brown sugar and double-fry KFC method, made ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together dark brown sugar, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Heat 1 tablespoon of ayurvedic ghee in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Double-fry the chicken kebabs by first searing them in the skillet for 5 minutes on each side, then baking them in the oven for 15 minutes.
Brush the kebabs with the remaining 1 tablespoon of ayurvedic ghee during the last 5 minutes of baking.
Serve the kicked up Turkish chicken kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
